title: Nazi occult documents found in a cave

tellings.quote: In 1945, near the end of the war, American forces uncovered a hidden stash of Nazi documents in a cave in southern Germany. Among them were records revealing real state-sponsored occult projects.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1945, near the end of the Second World War, American forces found a hidden stash of Nazi documents in a cave in southern Germany. According to him, these included records of real occult projects, meaning work on magic and the supernatural, paid for by the Nazi state. If true, it would mean a modern government took such things seriously enough to fund them.
